    Auslander's argument for successors #

    The dual of auslander': if the objects of a class P (indecomposable, nonzero, of bounded dimension) have left almost split families inside P, any indecomposable N receiving a nonzero map from a P-object is isomorphic to a P-object (auslanderL). Left almost split families into nonzero indecomposables exist (exists_lasFam).

    Type (u + 1)
